map.不可压才守恒？: Conservation only holds for incompressible flow?
map.不可压流体体积守恒 Q=Av；可压流需计密度变，质量守恒。: Incompressible fluids conserve volume as Q=Av; compressible flow needs the density change accounted for, so mass is conserved.
map.分流汇流节点流量平衡校核。: Checks flow balance at diversion confluence nodes.
map.变径管按流量守恒求各段流速。: For a tapered pipe, solve each segment velocity from flow continuity.
map.文丘里等装置前后流速关系。: The velocity relationship upstream and downstream of a Venturi and similar devices.
map.由入口断面、流速与出口断面，按 A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ 求变径后流速。: From inlet area, velocity and outlet area, use A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ to find the velocity after the diameter change.
map.节点 inflow=outflow，配合各支管 Q=Av 解流速分布。: At the node inflow=outflow, and each branch velocity follows from Q=Av.
map.节点怎么用？: How do I use the nodes?
map.：总管 Q=0.03 分两路各 0.015，按管径配流速避免偏流。: : main Q=0.03 split into two branches of 0.015 each, sized by diameter to avoid flow imbalance.
